statement: Pinned Dolphin models full IR as nine bytes per point: extended position/size, four seven-bit bounding fields, a reserved byte and an intensity byte. It computes bounds around simulated camera points in 10-bit coordinate space, truncates them when storing them in seven-bit fields, and computes synthetic intensity from those truncated stored bounds. Its point-size scaling is acknowledged as approximate. This does not establish retail size, bounding or intensity semantics.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Dolphin Camera.h:86-101 (seven-bit bounds); Camera.cpp:70-95,139-170, especially 153-165 (truncation on assignment, intensity computed from stored bounds). Unknown retail intensity remains open.
